# Guru

> > Guru is an AI-powered knowledge platform that delivers verified, permission-aware answers across enterprise tools and workflows.

Guru combines enterprise AI search, knowledge management automation, and agentic knowledge bases to create a single source of truth for organizations. The platform integrates with Slack, Salesforce, Google Drive, Microsoft Teams, and 100+ other tools, enabling teams across HR, sales, support, engineering, and operations to access accurate, cited information in their workflow.

## Key Topics

- Enterprise AI Search
- Knowledge Agents
- Knowledge Management Automation
- Slack Integration
- Permission-Aware Answers
- Enterprise AI Governance
- Agentic Knowledge Base
- Team Hubs
- Workplace AI Chat
- Knowledge Verification
- Browser Extensions
- Semantic Search
- MCP Server Integration
- Role-Based Access
- Enterprise Security
